name: Cherry Blossom House (Japanese House)
description: A japanese house with a pink tiled roof, a full-width balcony and two covered wings at ground level. The upper floor sits open behind the balcony rail, with blossom bushes framing each wing. Mostly wood and pink slabs. A centerpiece for a cherry grove base.
